purpose: Test whether a nested reconstruction objective supplies more reusable cross-seed functional compositions on a second model family
scope: Ten controlled SAEs on the exact same 16,777,216 natural training tokens; identical settings within each five-seed objective. Matryoshka uses original BatchTopK and prefix reconstruction implementation, so differences bundle objective and sparse activation rule. Fixed 256 validation sequences, source token hash exclusions; no benchmark or paired data in training. Training curve is not a convergence certificate. First 64 steps measure throughput; 9000-second loop guard saves exact state. No paid resources.
